propositions: The `resolved_statuses` config keys (jira and reconciler) have no active readers after task f020 deleted the inbound probe port and its consumer `classify_probe_response`
The keys were live and behaviour-affecting in shipped release v0.10.1 but became inert by v0.11.0, making hard removal a user-visible upgrade hazard without operator sign-off

Both config keys should be registered as scheduled deprecations (removal in v1.0.0) that still parse and validate identically while emitting warnings, deferring hard removal to a follow-up ticket requiring operator approval
The write-only datacenter transport plumbing (_TransportBase.resolved_statuses, JiraDataCenterSettings.resolved_statuses, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES) should be removed as behaviour-neutral cleanup
Documentation and config-read gate markers must be updated to reflect the deprecation status and point to the follow-up hard-removal ticket
